name: FLOOWBOX - Document Q&A Agent (PDF and DOCX)

parameters.text:
=Answer this question using only the provided document.

Question: {{ $json.question }}

Document content:
{{ $json.content }}

Rules:
- Answer only from the document
- Quote the exact passage when relevant
- If the answer is not in the document, say so clearly
- Provide page or section references where possible
- Be concise but complete

Return JSON:
{
  "answer": "",
  "relevant_quotes": ["exact quote from document"],
  "confidence": "high/medium/low",
  "not_found": false,
  "follow_up_questions": ["2 related questions the user might ask next"]
}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ answer: $json.answer, quotes: $json.relevant_quotes, confidence: $json.confidence, follow_up: $json.follow_up_questions, not_found: $json.not_found }) }}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Document Q&A Agent
Send any PDF or DOCX URL + a question.
Jina AI extracts full document text.
GPT-4o answers strictly from document content.
Returns: answer + exact quotes + confidence + follow-up questions.
All sessions logged to Airtable.

Works with PDFs, DOCX, web pages, Google Docs (public).
